method: Synchronous read lookahead; compare-and-forward read/write collision explicitly rather than relying on macro read-during-write. 1 read and 1 write each cycle, no arbitration/stalls. Physical ports are nine64-bit banks padded to576; upper30 mask bits0. Delay CE is always1 with nonzero read offset, so reset does not fan out to18 CE pins and exactD/startup unchanged.
geometry: Compiler-native32x64 m1, density W5.961/E5.903 pins/um. Nine-bank3x3 groups use43.2lattice origins and>=20um channels; actual gross302.4x172.8 allocation per logical port, external pin/PG access and routed timing still pending.
qualification: Timing, util, reset fanout, argmax pipelining and parent W/E landing prices require measured synth/benches before kit gate
std_flop_change_scope: Logical storage/reset allocation only; mapped total area, child reset sinks and native-clock timing still require whole-kit synthesis. Existing FIFO pointers remain unchanged; no guessed standard-cell area.
cfg_acceptance: Input config C commits C+2, next data C+3; static early-data fault, no ready/credit. Back-to-back config II1 preserved.
